<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
The task is to book a 30-minute meeting for four partners.
Alison has confirmed that she has booked the meeting for Friday at 11:30 AM.
My remaining task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

The agreed-upon time is Friday, November 20, at 11:30 AM.
I need to use the `send_confirmation_email` function.
The function requires the day, start time, and body of the email.
- `day`: "Fri"
- `start`: "11:30"
- `body`: I will write a standard confirmation email.

After sending the email, the task is complete. I should then end the session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: send_confirmation_email
function.arguments:
{"body":"Dear Partners,

This email is to confirm a 30-minute meeting for all four of you, which has been scheduled for next week.

The meeting will take place on Friday, November 20 at 11:30 AM Eastern Time.

Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Brad and Alison
Scheduling Assistants
Hale & Raman LLP","day":"Fri","start":"11:30"}
